groups.name: The MomCo (MOPS) meetups
groups.what: Moms groups for mothers of young children, meeting in your area or online. Many Ohio groups go by the older name, MOPS.
groups.how: Use the group search to find a meetup near you.

groups.name: La Leche League groups and leaders
groups.what: Breastfeeding support from trained volunteer leaders, with local group meetings.
groups.how: Open the map and move it to your part of Ohio, or use the A to Z list under it.

groups.name: POEM peer support groups for moms
groups.what: Support groups for mothers with depression or anxiety during pregnancy and after birth, run by Mental Health America of Ohio. Groups meet online and in person, with other moms who have been through it.
groups.how: Call or email poem@mhaohio.org and ask about the next group. Cincinnati: 513-202-4611. Dayton: 937-660-9220. This is not a crisis line.

groups.name: Postpartum Support International
groups.what: Peer support, education and referrals for moms and families during pregnancy and the first year after birth.
groups.how: Call the helpline, or use the website to find local support.

groups.name: Columbus Mom: guide to local moms groups
groups.what: A list of moms groups around Columbus, including neighborhood meetups and MOMS Club chapters.
groups.how: Pick a group near you and check its own page for the current schedule.

groups.name: Delaware County District Library events
groups.what: Baby storytimes and other free programs at the Delaware County library branches. Storytime is one of the easiest places to meet parents with kids the same age.
groups.how: Open the calendar and pick your branch.

groups.name: Cincinnati Mom Collective: moms groups
groups.what: A list of moms groups across Cincinnati, including MOMS Club, MOPS, breastfeeding and multiples groups.
groups.how: The list was last updated in 2020, so check each group's own page before you go.

groups.name: Cincinnati Mom Collective: family-friendly events
groups.what: A running calendar of family events around Cincinnati, with moms' nights out when they come up.
groups.how: Open the calendar and pick a date.

groups.name: Destination Dayton: holiday happenings
groups.what: Dayton-area holiday events, including free light displays and ice skating at RiverScape.
groups.how: Open each event for the current schedule.

groups.name: Northeast Ohio Parent: Find Your People
groups.what: A list of specialty parent support groups in the Cleveland and Akron area, from Northeast Ohio Parent magazine (May 2025).
groups.how: Read the list and contact the group that fits you.

groups.name: Northeast Ohio Parent events calendar
groups.what: Family events, classes and storytimes around Cleveland, Akron and the lakeshore.
groups.how: Open the calendar and pick a date.

groups.name: Destination Toledo: family-friendly events
groups.what: Family events around Toledo and northwest Ohio, including sensory friendly museum hours.
groups.how: Open the list and scroll by date.

groups.name: Toledo Parent calendar
groups.what: The events calendar from Toledo's parenting magazine.
groups.how: Open the calendar and filter by category.

groups.name: Marietta Main Street events
groups.what: Downtown Marietta events, including First Fridays with a Kid Central activity area.
groups.how: Open the calendar for dates and times.

groups.name: Hocking Hills area holiday events
groups.what: A 2026 list of family holiday events around Logan, Lancaster, Nelsonville and Chillicothe.
groups.how: Confirm each event with its organizer before you go.

groups.name: MOMS Club chapters in Ohio
groups.what: Local chapters for at-home moms, with playgroups and daytime meetups. The chapter list shows Akron-Canton East and West, Copley/Fairlawn, Delaware, Hilliard, Hudson, Lebanon, Medina East and West, North Royalton and Wayne County.
groups.how: Find your town on the chapter list. The list does not link to each chapter, so search the chapter name to reach it.

groups.name: Mom Brew Crew
groups.what: A free, casual monthly meetup for central Ohio moms at family-friendly breweries, hosted by Postpartum Together. Kids and partners are welcome.
groups.how: Check the page for the next date and just show up. No RSVP needed.

groups.name: FIT4MOM Columbus North
groups.what: Fitness classes for pregnant women and moms, including stroller workouts you bring the baby to, with a moms community around them. Classes are paid.
groups.how: The site offers a free first class. Use Find Your Location for where classes meet.

groups.name: Mount Carmel Moms Support Group
groups.what: A weekly drop-in for new moms in Columbus. A nurse answers questions and checks your blood pressure and your baby's weight, and you meet other moms.
groups.how: Every Thursday, 1:30 to 2:30 p.m., Medical Building 2, Room 100, 777 W. State Street. No sign-up. Bring your baby.

groups.name: Moms2B
groups.what: A community pregnancy program from Ohio State, with weekly sessions in person and online. It offers help with transportation and free supervised playtime for your other children.
groups.how: Call and ask where the nearest session meets.

groups.name: Mom and Baby Too! (University Hospitals)
groups.what: Free weekly groups for expectant and new mothers and their babies: Tuesdays 11 to noon at UH Landerbrook and Thursdays 11 to noon at UH Westlake, plus Zoom sessions.
groups.how: Call to confirm the next session. Westlake: 440-250-2035.

groups.name: Healthy Mom and Baby Program (online)
groups.what: A free online breastfeeding group every Tuesday, 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., run by University Hospitals with the Cuyahoga County WIC Program.
groups.how: Call to register with your name and email, and the link is sent to you.

groups.name: FIT4MOM Cleveland Westside
groups.what: Fitness classes for moms in Rocky River, Westlake and Avon, plus a Zoom option. Classes are paid.
groups.how: The site says the first class is free. Pick a location to see the schedule.

groups.name: FIT4MOM Central Cincinnati
groups.what: Pregnancy and postpartum fitness classes, including Stroller Strides, with a network of moms around them. Classes are paid.
groups.how: Open the site for locations and the class schedule.

groups.name: Visit Knox County: family events
groups.what: Family events around Mount Vernon and Gambier, including library storytimes when they are scheduled.
groups.how: Open the list and page through by date.
